paragraphs: In Yoma 2a, Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiya said in the name of Rabbi Machasya bar Idi, who said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב. gives Yoma 2a, not the older 2b placeholder. The exact William Davidson vocalized passage explicitly gives Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiya, Rabbi Machasya bar Idi, Rabbi Yochanan in that order.
That exact chain supports the distinct expanded titles, including Machasya’s heading occurrence, rather than blanket R' or a title inferred from metadata. No authority identity is admitted.
